refined_prompt: A Gia Rai man in traditional brocade attire plays the t'rung bamboo xylophone beside a stream. A man from the Gia Rai ethnic group, indigenous to the Central Highlands of Vietnam, is wearing a traditional costume adorned with intricate red and black patterns. He is playing a t'rung, a bamboo xylophone, near a serene, crystal-clear stream lined with lush green vegetation. The t'rung, crafted from polished bamboo tubes of varying lengths, produces a beautiful melody when struck, resonating in harmony with the gentle babbling of the stream and the sweet scent of the surrounding flora. The instrument is an essential part of their cultural heritage, used in daily life and special occasions such as religious ceremonies and festivals.
